The single hit was m51ed755 with E_CO2=-0.933, E_H2O=-0.867 and S=-0.898, hit=true [c0016]. After 20 labels the oracle calibration gave n=20, spearman=0.048 and auc=0.684 [c0018]. Round 3 bought 10 MOFs with hits_new=0 and hits_total=1 and spent 30 [c0025]. Calibration at n=30 gave spearman=-0.032 and auc=0.793 [c0027]. The final purchase bought 10 MOFs with hits_new=0 and hits_total=1 and spent 40 [c0034]. Overall 40 MOFs were bought and only 1 hit was found. The cheap simulator S_mace showed weak and declining rank correlation with DFT S, moving from spearman=0.418 to 0.048 to -0.032, while AUC rose to 0.793. With the DFT budget exhausted there are no further DFT labels to buy in this campaign.
